description: Collect your guests' photos in one album: print a QR code, they scan it and add theirs. Weddings, birthdays, parties. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: create (default) makes an empty event album and returns its link — print it as a QR code for guests. list returns the caller's event albums with how many guest photos wait for approval. moderate approves or removes guests' photos in one album, or puts its photos in order, by the item ids it gives.

approve.description: moderate only: ids of waiting guest photos to show in the album.

duration.description: How long the album stays open: 7d, 30d (default), and on Pro also 90d, 1y or never.

intro.description: A short message to guests under the name, e.g. 'Add your photos from the day'.

order.description: moderate only: photo ids in the order the album should show them; photos not named follow in their current order.

remove.description: moderate only: ids of guest photos to take out; their files are deleted from storage.

title.description: The event's name, shown at the top of the album, up to 120 characters. Required for create.

token.description: The album's token, from create or list. Required for moderate.
